content: If the newly received diagnostic service is allowed in the current Diagnostic Session ( see [SWS_Dcm_00211]), but the requested subservice is not allowed in the current Diagnostic Session (according to the configuration parameter DcmDsdSubServiceSessionLevelRef ), the DSD submodule shall transmit a neg- ative response with NRC 0x7E (subFunctionNotSupportedInActiveSession) to the DSL submodule.
